repo_notes.content: This is a Java 21 / Maven learning repository for Low Level Design (LLD). It has two halves: (1) design-principle and design-pattern examples under src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/ (video1solid, creationalpatterns, structuralpatterns, behavioralpatterns, additionalpatterns), mostly as problem/violation vs solution pairs, and (2) full LLD interview problems under src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/interviewquestions/, one package per system. The interview problems are the highest priority and should be documented in depth.
repo_notes.author: Repository owner

repo_notes.content: Every package under src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/interviewquestions/ has a README.md that documents its entry point, folder structure, every class and its design notes. Use these READMEs as the primary source for page structure, then verify and expand from the Java source. The root README.md indexes all packages.
repo_notes.author: Repository owner

repo_notes.content: There is no single application entry point: every LLD problem and pattern example is a standalone demo with its own main method (e.g. ChessDemo, PlayGame, ATMRoom, BookMyShowApp, ParkingLotClient, PaymentGateway, Demo). For each LLD page include: problem statement and requirements, entry point and what the demo does, a Mermaid class diagram of the main classes and relationships, a Mermaid sequence or state diagram of the main flow, the design patterns used and why, concurrency/thread-safety handling where present, and known simplifications or extension points.
repo_notes.author: Repository owner

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the repository's purpose and layout (patterns vs LLD interview problems), Java 21 / Maven setup from pom.xml, how to run any demo via its main class from an IDE, and a navigation table of every LLD system with its package and entry point.

pages.title: SOLID Principles
pages.purpose: Document src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/video1solid: each SOLID principle (single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation, dependency inversion) with its violation vs solution classes and why the solution is better.

pages.title: Creational Patterns
pages.purpose: Document src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/creationalpatterns: singleton (including double-checked locking fix), simple factory, factory method, abstract factory, builder, prototype and object pool, with problem vs solution classes and class diagrams.

pages.title: Structural Patterns
pages.purpose: Document src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/structuralpatterns: adapter, bridge, composite (file structure, math expression), decorator, facade, flyweight (word processor, robotic game) and proxy, with problem vs solution classes and class diagrams.

pages.title: Behavioral Patterns
pages.purpose: Document src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/behavioralpatterns: strategy, observer, state (vending machine), command, chain of responsibility, iterator, mediator, memento, template method, visitor and interpreter, with problem vs solution classes and class diagrams.

pages.title: Additional Patterns
pages.purpose: Document src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/additionalpatterns: null object pattern and MVC, with their problem/solution and model/view/controller classes.

pages.title: LLD Interview Problems
pages.purpose: Introduce the src/main/java/com/conceptcoding/interviewquestions/ package: a comparison table of all 13 systems (ATM, BookMyShow, Car Rental, Chess, Coupon Application, Cricbuzz, Elevator, Meeting Scheduler, Parking Lot, Payment Gateway, Snake and Ladder, Splitwise, Tic-Tac-Toe) listing entry point, core entities, design patterns used and whether concurrency is handled.

pages.title: ATM State Machine and Cash Dispensing

pages.title: BookMyShow Seat Locking and Booking Flow

pages.title: Car Rental Reservations and Concurrency

pages.title: Cricbuzz Match Simulation and Scorecards

pages.title: Elevator Scheduling and Concurrency
pages.purpose: Detail how external requests are dispatched via ElevatorSelectionStrategy (NearestElevatorStrategy, LeastBusyStrategy), the InternalDispatcher singleton, per-controller threads with up/down priority queues and wait/notify, and door/direction state.

pages.title: Parking Lot Strategies and Thread Safety
pages.purpose: Detail the entry/exit flow, spot lookup, pricing and payment strategies, spot managers per vehicle type, and per-spot-manager ReentrantLock thread safety.

pages.title: Payment Gateway Layering and Transactions
pages.purpose: Detail the controller → service → model layering, InstrumentServiceFactory selection of BankService/CardService, the transaction processing flow and status, and in-memory storage.

pages.title: Splitwise Expense Splitting and Balances
pages.purpose: Detail equal/unequal/percentage split validation via SplitFactory, how BalanceSheetController updates UserExpenseBalanceSheet per expense, and a worked example of balances after several expenses.

pages.title: Concurrency Across LLD Designs
pages.purpose: Compare concurrency handling across BookMyShow, Car Rental, Elevator and Parking Lot (locks, concurrent maps, threads, wait/notify, deadlock avoidance), and note designs that are single-threaded.
